# boxbox_tenant (Resource)

A tenant: its pool, its user `<name>@pve`, its internal network and its quota. Owner only.

**The server does not implement this yet** (it answers `501`): the resource follows the shape the API contract specifies.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tenant: 2-8 characters of a-z and 0-9, starting with a letter, not `admin`. Changing it replaces the tenant.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Address Cloudflare Access lets the tenant in with.
- `quota` (Attributes) What the tenant's machines may add up to. Without it the tenant cannot create machines itself. Lowering it below the usage is allowed: new requests are refused, existing machines are not touched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The tenant's name; also the import ID.
- `network` (String) The tenant's internal network (CIDR), as PVE has it.
- `usage` (Attributes) What all machines in the tenant's pool add up to now. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))

<a id="nestedatt--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota`

Required:

- `cpu` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota--cpu))
- `disk` (String) Disks in total, as asked for (replicas are not counted again).
- `machines` (Number) Number of machines.
- `memory` (String) Memory in total (`"8GiB"`).

Optional:

- `ha` (Boolean) Whether the tenant may ask for `ha.replicas`. Default `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--quota--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota.cpu`

Required:

- `max` (Number) Visible threads in total.
- `min` (Number) Guaranteed threads in total, in steps of 0.05.



<a id="nestedatt--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage--cpu))
- `disk` (String)
- `machines` (Number)
- `memory` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--usage--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage.cpu`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number)
- `min` (Number)
